problem: Reduce multi-view generation cost and compounding model error during VLA reinforcement fine-tuning.
contribution: VLA-MBPO combines a Bagel unified multimodal dynamics/reward model, interleaved view decoding and short chunk-level branched rollouts. Primary title is Towards Practical World Model-based Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models; method name differs from title.
algorithm: Tokenize continuous action chunks as vocabulary integers; predict future endpoint images and discounted chunk reward without intermediate frames. Generate head view then wrist view conditioned on predicted head image. Start1–4chunk rollouts from actual replay states, train flow-noise PPO/value head with chunk-discounted GAE. Short rollout bound trades model-error accumulation against policy/distribution error; assumes bounded rewards and defined total-variation errors.
observations: Head/wrist images, instruction and aligned action chunks. Model not originally action-pretrained, so downstream task episodes are required. Reward and observation from same UMM can share mistakes.
actions: Dataset-specific continuous actions discretized to0–256-styleinteger tokens; flow-policy denoising actions optimized withPPO. Integer mapping is not universal joint identity, calibration or tool geometry.
embodiment_and_data: LIBERO four suites; offline50rollouts/task from pi0.5 withone-trajectorySFT,50evaluationepisodes/task. World-model benchmarkObject suite50training/10heldouttrajectories per task. PhysicalArxX5 cable/towel andGalaxyR1 cup/pen/wipe:50–100expertdemos plus50policyrollouts/task,50evaluation trials(30seen,20unseen).
experiments: Multi-view video/reward fidelity, simulation success, physical seen/unseen and rollout horizon/sample-size ablations. Compared reward accuracy/F1 differ because of class imbalance; inspect both. Theory compares error-dependent bounds, not unconditional physical performance guarantees or proof that pessimism is never needed.
baselines: Ctrl-World dynamics,Qwen3VL8B reward; UMM withoutpretraining/interleavedviews. PolicySFT,syntheticBC,matched-real-budgetpiRL andIDQL. Claim of sufficiently accurate model to omit conservative regularization is empirical within tested data, not a general theorem.

limitations: Sample generation still consumes large compute; target-data finetuning required, zero-shot world-model generalization remains future work. Chunk-skipping may hide intermediate contact errors. Joint dynamics/reward errors, partial observations and out-of-support actions remain concerns; theoreticalbound relies on errors not measured for new hardware.
code_and_license: No independent code/model/data license inspection or code execution. Bagel/pi0.5/source data terms require individual checks. No zero-shotcheckpoint portability inferred.

Actual camera calibration and target action semantics are prerequisites. CurrentNXcamera recording is not a trained Bagelworldmodel; preservelegacycontroller settings.
